# Rainbow Preschool International
> Thane's most trusted preschool since 2007. Playgroup, Nursery and Kindergarten for children aged 1.5 to 6 years across 6 centres in Thane, Maharashtra, India.

## About
Rainbow Preschool International has been serving families in Thane since 2007 — over 18 years of early childhood education. More than 1,00,000 children have learned with us. All staff are female. Admissions are open for the 2026–27 academic year.

- Founded: 2007
- Location: Thane, Maharashtra, India
- Centres: 6 (across Thane West and Thane East)
- Age range: 1.5 years to 6 years
- Staff: 100% female
- Rating: 4.9/5 (487 parent reviews)
- Admissions contact: +91 82915 68972

## Programmes

### Playgroup (Ages 1.5–2.5 years)
A gentle introduction to structured learning through play and sensory exploration. Batch size: 10–12 children.

### Nursery (Ages 2.5–3.5 years)
Language development, early numeracy, motor skills and social confidence. Batch size: 12–15 children.

### Kindergarten (Ages 3.5–5.5 years)
School readiness, reading, writing, logical thinking and creative expression. Batch size: 12–15 children.

### Happy Times
Happy Times is Rainbow Preschool's after-school enrichment and daycare programme for children aged 2 to 10 years. It offers art, music, dance, sports, and creative play, operating from 9 AM to 6 PM at select centres — an ideal option for working parents.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is the admission process at Rainbow Preschool?
A: Admissions are open year-round. Select your preferred programme and centre, schedule a campus visit, fill out the admission form, submit required documents, and complete enrollment. Call 82915 68972 to start.

Q: What age groups do you accept?
A: We accept children aged 1.5 to 6 years. Programmes: Playgroup (1.5–2.5 years), Nursery (2.5–3.5 years), and Kindergarten (3.5–5.5 years). Happy Times extended care for ages 2–10.

Q: What safety measures are in place?
A: 24/7 CCTV surveillance, controlled entry/exit, verified pickup system, 100% female teaching staff, first-aid trained staff, fire safety equipment, and child-proofed facilities.

Q: What curriculum does Rainbow Preschool follow?
A: A play-based, activity-driven curriculum covering cognitive, social, emotional, physical, and language development. Teachers are ECE and Montessori certified.

Q: What are the school timings?
A: All centres operate Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Both half-day and full-day options are available.

Q: How many centres does Rainbow Preschool have?
A: 6 centres across Thane: Manpada, Hariniwas (Naupada), Anand Nagar (Majiwada), Dhokali (Kolshet Road), Kalwa, and Kasarvadavali (Ghodbunder Road).

## Full About Content

Rainbow Preschool International was founded in 2007 with a single centre in Thane. Today, it operates 6 centres across Thane West, providing quality early childhood education to thousands of families. Over 1,00,000 young learners have passed through Rainbow's classrooms in more than 18 years of operation.

Our mission is to provide a safe, nurturing, and stimulating environment where every child can develop to their fullest potential through play-based learning.

Our values: child-centric approach to education; safe and nurturing environment; play-based learning methodology; strong parent-school partnership; continuous teacher development.

Programmes offered:
- Playgroup (1.5–2.5 years) — play-based learning and socialisation for toddlers
- Nursery (2.5–3.5 years) — early literacy, numeracy, and confidence building
- Kindergarten (3.5–5.5 years, Jr. KG + Sr. KG) — full school-readiness programme

Our 6 centres across Thane:
- Manpada — Near Khewra Circle
- Hariniwas — Naupada, Central Thane (Panchpakadi)
- Anand Nagar — Majiwada, opposite Tropical Lagoon
- Dhokali — Kolshet Road
- Kalwa — Eastern Thane (Manisha Nagar)
- Kasarvadavali — Ghodbunder Road, behind Hypercity Mall

## Full Admissions Detail

Admissions are open for the 2026–27 academic year. Rainbow Preschool accepts children aged 1.5 to 5.5 years across four programmes. Age is calculated as of June 1st of the academic year.

Age criteria:
- Playgroup: 1.5–2.5 years (first structured learning experience)
- Nursery: 2.5–3.5 years (language, phonics, fine motor, independence)
- Junior KG: 3.5–4.5 years (pre-reading, early writing, structured play)
- Senior KG: 4.5–5.5 years (full school-readiness for Class 1 transition)

Admission steps:
1. Submit an enquiry online, by phone (+91 82915 68972), or walk into any of the 6 centres (Mon–Sat, 9 AM–6 PM)
2. Schedule a free campus tour at your preferred centre — classrooms, play areas, safety installations
3. Speak with the admissions team about programme, batch timing, and any questions
4. Complete the formal registration form at the centre
5. Submit required documents: child's birth certificate, 4–6 passport-size photographs, parent ID proof (Aadhaar/passport/voter ID/driving licence), address proof, child's Aadhaar if available, vaccination card, and previous school records if applicable
6. Pay the admission fee to confirm your child's seat and attend the parent orientation session

The full admission process typically takes 3 to 5 working days from enquiry to confirmed admission. Provisional admission can be granted with a 30-day document submission commitment if any document is unavailable at the time.

Admission timeline:
- October–November: Early admission window — preferred centres and batch timings available
- December–February: Main admission window — widest seat availability across all 6 centres
- March–May: Final round — seats at Manpada and Hariniwas fill quickly
- June onwards: Mid-term admissions subject to seat availability; ideal for families relocating to Thane

Fees include a one-time admission fee (registration, orientation, starter kit), monthly or term-based tuition, an activity fee (art, music, dance, yoga, sports, field trips), and an optional transport fee for GPS-tracked vehicles with female attendants. Flexible payment plans are available — monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or annual. No hidden charges. Full fee breakdown is shared before admission is confirmed. For exact fees at your preferred centre, call +91 82915 68972.

Campus visits are strongly encouraged before enrolling. During the visit: guided tour of classrooms, play areas, washrooms, kitchen, and safety installations; meeting with the centre head and teaching staff; observation of an ongoing class; free trial class for your child; and clear answers on fees, timings, transport, and the full process. Book a visit by calling +91 82915 68972 or filling the enquiry form at https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-admissions.
